name: Ashvawg Tamer
summary: Ashvawg Tamers are druids who have chosen to bond with a strange and monstrous creature.
replacesText: Resist Nature's Lure, one less Wild Shape/day, Venom Immunity

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: Eliminate Diplomacy and Heal from the druid’s class skill list. Add Intimidate and Knowledge (arcana).

features.name: Bestial Bond (Sp)
features.summary: At 4th level, the druid can call out to savage powers of the wilds, entreating them to aid her and her companion. Doing so allows her to cast cure serious wounds , neutralize poison , or remove disease on her animal companion as a spell-like ability by channeling the power of nature. The druid does not need to have these spells prepared as they come directly from the goddess. Using this ability, however, causes the druid to take 1d4 points of Wisdom damage. Any effect that prevents this Wisdom damage from occurring also prevents the use of this ability.

features.name: Variant Companion (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level the druid adds additional non-animals to her alternate list of animal companions. If she chooses one of these creatures as an animal companion, she may use her wild empathy ability to influence the creature (even though it is not an animal and its intelligence may be above 2), though she takes a –4 penalty on this check. If the druid and the companion share a common language these checks are not needed. If the companion’s intelligence is 3 or higher, the number of “tricks” the druid can teach it refers to the number of commands the creature understands regardless of language.

progressionProfiles.label: Monstrous Companion Access

values.effectiveLevel: Full Druid level; hippogriff uses Druid level - 3

progressionProfiles.summary: The Animal Companion selector unlocks each monstrous option at its legal class level and the companion sheet applies its individual effective-level penalty.

features.name: Undying Bond (Sp)
features.summary: At 6th level the druid can use her bestial bond ability to cast resurrection on her animal companion.

appliedEffect.description: Bestial Bond dealt {amount} points of Wisdom damage. Remove this tracked damage when it is healed.

confirmations.label: Nothing prevents the required Wisdom damage

resourceActions.summary: Cast resurrection on your animal companion and automatically roll and track the required 1d4 Wisdom damage.

features.name: Exotic Companion (Ex)
features.summary: At 9th level the druid adds additional non-animals to her alternate list of animal companions, all of them with higher intelligence and strange shapes. It otherwise functions as the variant companion ability.

features.name: Resist Nature's Lure
features.summary: The druid does not gain this ability.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: The druid does not gain her second daily use of her wild shape ability at level 6. Hereafter she has one fewer daily use of the ability than a standard druid of her level.

features.name: Venom Immunity (Ex)
features.summary: The druid does not gain this ability.

mechanicalNotes: Class-skill exchanges, all eleven level-gated monstrous companion choices and their effective-level adjustments, variant-companion Wild Empathy, Bestial Bond and Undying Bond spell-like actions with rolled persistent Wisdom damage, and the lost level-6 Wild Shape use are automated.
